A.claim: Curvature stratification: |chi| < T is a FINITE set of Beal signatures precisely when T < 1/3 (since with x=y=3 the reciprocal sum is 2/3 + 1/z, bounded iff 1-T > 2/3). There are exactly 4 signatures with 1/12 <= |chi| < 1/6, 13 with |chi| < 1/4, and 29 with |chi| < 3/10, over reduced exponents with x <= y.

B.claim: No Beal counterexample of signature (2m,2n,3) with m>=4 and n>=4. Even m or even n: signature (4,2n,3) / (2m,4,3), excluded by BCDY 2015 Thm 1. Both odd (>=5): C odd forces a+bi=(u+vi)^3 in Z[i]; on whichever side 3 does not divide the parameter, (s^2)^m+(-eps t)^m=3v^2 with m odd, forbidden by Bennett-Skinner 2004 Thm 1.1 (C=3).
